scope: isolated selected-hecs and executor conformance; not production, durable DB or full boss parity

storage.unit: update visits every base entity including those without optional state; budget divides batch p99 by fixed total entity count, not an individual entity tail; a 10000-entity batch is allowed 500ms by this lab bound, not a 10ms server tick
storage.cost_boundary: update, optional-state churn, active-detached-active transfer and observable materialization measured separately

dispatch.sizing_hypothesis: 20 bounded root transitions per hypothetical 10ms frame may consume 1ms; workload frequency and production headroom unmeasured
dispatch.unit: one root invocation including all admitted module fanout, host calls and synchronous nested callbacks; budgets reset only at root entry

resources.native_boundary: trusted native computation has no fuel/preemption or panic-isolation guarantee; admitted calls/state/depth remain bounded

controls.functional_oracle: exact ordered trace, callback/action results and complete state/identity/residence/revision/contributions; checksums only supplementary
controls.architecture: record actual host; never pool aarch64 and x86_64
controls.statistics: min/median/max across all independent runs; p99 of 200 ticks is a noisy batch diagnostic, not a reliable rare tail
controls.budget_boundary: provisional lab rejection limits only; no server SLA, no claim of victory over an unmeasured registry or dense store

freeze.phase_one: two independent module crates tested through native Rust, actual Rust Core Wasm, actual C Core Wasm and mixed execution
freeze.phase_two: hash entire source/driver/adapter/bindings tree before authoring third module; check freeze.py exact file set
freeze.phase_three: new independent crate/state/lifecycle; only own source and reviewed dependency/declarative composition edits
freeze.required_review: inspect allowed declarative diffs; digest equality is not alone semantic conformance
freeze.on_required_host_fix: retain failed challenge, correct and revalidate before a genuinely new independent extension challenge
